title: 第一卷 第4章 雪越大越想杀人！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“以后，有我在，不会让任何人再欺负你了！”

秦云揉了揉赵佛儿的脑袋，轻声道。

“娘！这是我打回来的猎物！”

安抚好赵佛儿后，秦云又赶忙扶起了秦王氏。

这才把背在身后的小熊崽子拎了出来。

“佛儿你照顾一下母亲！我去做饭！”

接着，秦云便拎着小熊崽去了灶台旁！

从腰包里拿出弯刀就麻利地剥皮。

刀虽然断了一截，但刀刃还算锋利，三两下就把熊皮完整地剥了下来。

肉切块，丢进锅里，加水，放盐，生火。

不到半个时辰，锅里就飘出了肉香。

秦云端了两碗肉进屋。

一碗给了秦王氏，另一碗递给了赵佛儿。

秦王氏似乎今天受到的惊吓不小，喝了几口肉汤，便靠在炕头慢慢睡着了。

而赵佛儿接过碗，低着头，小口小口地吃着。

她吃饭的动作很斯文！

即便是饿极了，也还是保持着一种骨子里的优雅。

“官人你不吃吗？”

吃到一半，她抬起头，看了秦云一眼。

“不急！”

“接下来，我有点事去办，佛儿你慢慢吃着，记得关好门！”

“我不回来，谁叫门也别开！”

又给赵佛儿盛了一碗肉后！

秦云直接推开门走到了院子里！

此刻，天已经彻底黑了！

雪也越下越大！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"From now on, as long as I'm here, I won't let anyone bully you again!"

Qin Yun rubbed Zhao Foer's head and said softly.

"Mom! This is the prey I brought back!"

After comforting Zhao Fo'er, Qin Yun hurriedly helped Prince Qin up.

Only then did he take out the little bear cub that was carried on his back.

"Fo'er, take care of your mother! I'll cook!"

Then, Qin Yun carried the little bear cub to the stove!

He took out the machete from his belt bag and quickly peeled off the skin.

Although the knife was broken in part, the blade was still sharp and the bear's skin was completely peeled off in a few strokes.

Cut the meat into pieces, throw it into the pot, add water, salt, and light a fire.

In less than half an hour, the aroma of meat wafted out of the pot.

Qin Yun brought two bowls of meat into the room.

One bowl was given to Prince Qin, and the other bowl was handed to Zhao Foer.

Prince Qin seemed to have been quite frightened today. After drinking a few mouthfuls of broth, he leaned on the kang and fell asleep slowly.

Zhao Fo'er took the bowl, lowered his head, and ate in small bites.

The way she eats is very graceful!

Even though he was extremely hungry, he still maintained a kind of elegance in his bones.

"Master, don't you want to eat?"

Halfway through eating, she raised her head and glanced at Qin Yun.

"No rush!"

"Next, I have something to do, Buddha, eat slowly and remember to close the door!"

"If I don't come back, don't open the door!"

After serving another bowl of meat to Zhao Foer!

Qin Yun opened the door and walked into the yard!

At this moment, it is completely dark!

The snow is getting heavier and heavier!
